# Captions

An image alone in its paragraph with alt text becomes a captioned figure.

![A chart: *stars*, under_score & 100% of $5 {braces}](chart.png)

An image without alt text is a plain image and has no caption.

![](chart.png "=90")

Images also work inside lists, tables and links.

- ![In a list](chart.png "=60")

| Column | Picture |
|--------|---------|
| one    | ![In a cell](chart.png "=40") |
